text:
ida: deploybot alert: sudden increase in 5xx errors after release v2.10.3 at 02:15 UTC, affects hosted/gateway. Suggests rollback. Proposing manual revert to v2.10.1 for safety window.

deploybot: Recommendation: full rollback to v2.10.1 (confidence 0.79). Signals: 5xx rate 4.6% (baseline 0.3%), streaming aborts up 9%. Awaiting operator confirm.

jon: oncall. I saw spike correlating with the new streaming buffer change. +1 to revert. Prefer staged 25/50/100 to watch for downstream errors.

ryan: agree. I'll prepare a customer-facing line if needed. Ping legal if SLA might be touched.

ida: executing staggered shift now:
```
redwoodctl traffic split --env prod --from v2.10.3 --to v2.10.1 --pct-start 25 --pct-final 100 --step-interval 3m --reason "streaming buffer regression"
```

deploybot: Job jb-90021 created. step1 25% shifting.

jon: step1 done. 5xx down to 2.1%. No new regressions in logs. proceeding to step2 in 3m.

ida: moved to 100% after step2 completed early; monitoring.

deploybot: Shift complete. All traffic on v2.10.1. 5xx back to 0.35%.

ryan: applying pin for 45m and disabling auto-rollforward. Command: `redwoodctl pin --env prod --version v2.10.1 --ttl 45m --reason "safety after 5xx spike"`

ops-bot: Incident stub posted to #statuspage. Draft customer blurb queued.

jon: created ticket INF-5533 and assigned to runtime team for buffer investigation. Also note to revert streaming buffer change in next canary until fix validated.

ida: closing immediate rollback thread. We'll reopen if error rates climb. Thanks all. :pray:
